title: Prepare and check model choices
responsibility: Converts listed provider models for display and checks the requested model and effort.

inputs.name: providerModels.models
inputs.description: The provider's models as CodexModel records: model identifier, display name, hidden flag, supported reasoning efforts, default effort and default-model flag. Records whose hidden flag is true are dropped, and every other record is mapped without validation, so each of them needs a supportedReasoningEfforts array.

inputs.name: validateModel.models
inputs.description: The model choices that validateModel searches, each with id, label, efforts, defaultEffort and isDefault. validateModel checks only the first choice whose id strictly equals the requested model, and an empty list or a list with no matching id makes validateModel throw.

inputs.name: validateModel.model
inputs.description: The exact model identity requested, compared with === to each choice's id, so no trimming or case folding happens. A value that matches no choice makes validateModel throw.

inputs.name: validateModel.effort
inputs.description: The reasoning effort to check against the selected choice's efforts. Null and the empty string skip the check; any other value must match one of those efforts exactly or validateModel throws, and no default effort is substituted.

outputs.name: providerModels
outputs.description: The visible models in input order, each with id taken from model, label from displayName, efforts listing the reasoningEffort values of supportedReasoningEfforts in their original order, and defaultEffort and isDefault copied unchanged. Hidden records are the only ones removed, and nothing is sorted or deduplicated.

outputs.name: validateModel
outputs.description: validateModel returns nothing: it completes normally only when a choice with the requested id exists and any nonempty requested effort is among that choice's efforts. It never substitutes a default model or effort.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by validateModel when no choice has the requested model id, and thrown when a nonempty requested effort is not among the selected choice's efforts. Both are ExpectedCliError objects with fixed messages.
